cell-structure: Describe the structure of eukaryotic cells (animal and plant) and prokaryotic cells
Explain how the main sub-cellular structures of eukaryotic cells are related to their functions, including the nucleus, cytoplasm, cell membrane, mitochondria, chloroplasts, ribosomes and cell wall
Explain how the main sub-cellular structures of prokaryotic cells are related to their functions
Understand the difference between animal and plant cells (cell wall, chloroplasts, vacuole)
photosynthesis: Describe the process of photosynthesis and the word equation
Explain the importance of photosynthesis in the conversion of light energy to chemical energy
Describe the structure of the leaf and explain how it is adapted for photosynthesis
Understand that the rate of photosynthesis may be limited by light intensity, temperature and concentration of carbon dioxide
Describe experiments to investigate the effect of light or temperature on the rate of photosynthesis
eukaryotes-prokaryotes: Describe the structural differences between eukaryotic and prokaryotic cells
Compare the structure of animal, plant and bacterial cells
Explain the role of the nucleus and plasmids in prokaryotic cells
respiration: Describe cellular respiration as an exothermic reaction
Describe the process of aerobic respiration and the word equation
Describe the process of anaerobic respiration in animals and in yeast
Explain the importance of respiration in living organisms
